data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Gargee is the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. She is the embodiment of knowledge and learning. She is often depicted as holding a lamp or book, symbolizing enlightenment. The name Gargee carries the meaning “Goddess of knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gargee usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
